questions.q: During which stage of Prophase I does crossing over occur?
questions.qPa: Prophase I ਦੇ ਕਿਸ ਪੜਾਅ ਦੌਰਾਨ crossing over ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ?
questions.explanation: Crossing over (exchange of genetic material between non-sister chromatids) occurs during the Pachytene stage, facilitated by recombination nodules.

questions.q: A cell has 14 chromosomes and 2C amount of DNA in G1 phase. What will be the number of chromosomes and the amount of DNA after the S phase?
questions.explanation: In the S phase, DNA replicates so the amount doubles (2C to 4C). However, the sister chromatids remain attached to the same centromere, so the chromosome number remains the same (14).

questions.q: Which of the following events occurs during Anaphase I of meiosis?
questions.explanation: In Anaphase I, homologous chromosomes separate and move to opposite poles. The centromeres do NOT split (that happens in Anaphase II).

questions.q: The X-shaped structures representing the sites of crossing over are called Chiasmata. In which stage do they become clearly visible?
questions.explanation: As the synaptonemal complex dissolves in Diplotene, the homologous chromosomes separate except at the sites of crossover, making the X-shaped chiasmata clearly visible.
